about_the_game:
Play for free. Win real prizes. Survive the cartoon apocalypse.

Tooncop is a fast-paced, first-person horde shooter where your skill unlocks real-world rewards. No pay-to-win. No battle passes. No cosmetics-for-grinding. Just pure arcade-style gameplay with tangible prizes on the line.

In Tooncop, you’ve got 15 minutes to survive relentless waves of rogue cartoon enemies, rack up XP, and chase down high scores. Each map contains loot chests with score targets—beat the score, open the chest, and earn tickets for real prize draws.

🎁 DROP 2 is now live!
This time, there’s only ONE PlayStation 5 up for grabs.
There are three chests to unlock, each with escalating score challenges:

  • 🟢 Easy Chest = 1 Ticket

  • 🟡 Medium Chest = 5 Tickets

  • 🔴 Hard Chest = 10 Tickets

Every ticket you claim counts as an entry into the PS5 prize draw (date TBA).
You’ll also find artisan-crafted items and signed music memorabilia hidden throughout the game.

🎥 Just record your run and submit it at the official website to claim your tickets.

💡 This isn’t just a game—it’s a new way to play.
No microtransactions. No gimmicks. Just real loot, earned through real gameplay.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 980
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Battle rogue cartoons in Tooncop, a fast-paced FPS horde shooter! Survive 15 minutes, level up, and rack up cash while taking down waves of mischievous toons. Hit the score target to unlock loot boxes—with real prizes on the line! Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate Tooncop?
